text:
Yara (AE): Heads up — prospect asked for our full CAIQ responses + any control exceptions and a simple 'who's responsible' blurb for encryption/KMS for their legal/security kickoff. Also need a 2-week POC price for Dedicated vs hosted-with-CMK. Can someone own end-to-end?

Jon (Security): I can handle the CAIQ export and highlight exceptions. Quick question: do they require cross-region key replication or strict EU-only key residence? That changes control statuses (e.g., CCM-ENC-03).

Marta (SE): From the RFP: EU keys preferred, but they can accept cross-region for failover if keys remain customer-managed. Traffic ~5 rps, 8k tokens, want isolation for audit reasons.

ops-bot: CAIQ reference (internal): https://redwood.internal/security/ca iq/CAIQ-2025-export (last updated 2025-12-04)

Jon (Security): Plan: I'll mark controls as Green/Amber/Red and add short rationale. Example:
- CCM-ENC-01 (data in transit): GREEN 12 TLS 1.2+ enforced, mTLS optional.
- CCM-ENC-04 (customer-managed keys): AMBER 12 we support CMK via AWS/GCP KMS but require grant/IAM config; key residency depends on customer's KMS settings.
- CCM-OPS-07 (host-level access): RED 12 on hosted plans we maintain host access; Dedicated/Private reduces our access surface per SLA.

Marta (SE): For the shared-responsibility summary (one-pager) I'll draft plain language bullets:
- Redwood: runs the model servers, takes care of host patching, disk encryption for platform artifacts, network encryption between components.
- Customer: controls what they send to Redwood, owns client-side secrets (API keys), and manages KMS keys if CMK selected.
- With CMK: customer issues crypto grants; revoking grants will prevent Redwood from decrypting request/response payloads.

Alex (Pricing): Cost sketch:
- Dedicated POC (1x A10G-equivalent reserved + private network + storage + setup): USD 16,800 for 2 weeks (includes 48h setup SLA and a small burst buffer).
- Hosted-with-CMK (shared infra + KMS integration + logs forwarding): USD 2,900 for 2 weeks.
- Private (on-prem/VPC package): needs infra quote + deployment fee (~add USD 12k).
Numbers are rough; I can itemize CPU/GPU hours, storage, egress, and setup labor.

Yara (AE): Great. Jon, please attach exported CAIQ with flags and short mitigations. Marta, add a 1-page runbook: VPC peering steps, IAM grant snippet, smoke test curl commands. Alex, spreadsheet with line-item pricing.

Jon (Security): Will export and annotate. I'll call out exceptions around host-level access and key residency. ETA: 6pm today.

Marta (SE): Runbook draft by 3pm. I'll include example IAM policy and smoke test:
```
# Smoke test (example)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFWD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":1000}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

Alex (Pricing): I'll upload the detailed quote to the shared drive and ping when ready. ETA 4:30pm.

Yara (AE): I'll tell the customer 48h turnaround and flag that Dedicated needs extra setup time. Thanks team :thumbsup:
